description: This file defines repository classes for handling database operations related to Users and Tasks in a task management system. It includes CRUD operations, error handling, and data validation, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for interaction with the database.

classes.name: RepositoryError
classes.description: Base repository exception for controlled error handling.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password, ensuring email uniqueness and input validation.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns the user if authentication succeeds.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user, validating input.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Lists all tasks for a particular user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task belonging to a user by task ID.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates fields of a task, ensuring only the owner can modify and validating input.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a task if it belongs to the specified user.
